recovery-story.text: If you lose your everyday device, recover using a saved encrypted box and an enrolled key at the original website. Each record has a title and named fields for accounts, recovery keys, codes and instructions. Copy any value, reveal hidden fields deliberately, or follow permitted URL fields. Keep a backup outside the browser and a spare enrolled key. The architecture pages retain a pinned pre-feature snapshot; development documents the current record and session modules. Their implementation does not complete the separately planned independent audit and simulation.
